name: Danganronpa: Depresja Soul
source:
Sixteen students enter an elite academy. Due to unknown circumstances, they find themselves in an unfamiliar location with no exits. The only way to escape is to kill and not be caught.

[Translated from [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DanganronpaDSoul-vv6pew/753974]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
十六名学生进入精英学院。由于未知的情况，他们发现自己处于一个陌生的地方，没有出口。逃脱的唯一方法就是杀死而不被抓住。

[译自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DanganronpaDSoul-vv6pew/753974]GameJolt[/url]]
